idle.note: the protagonist's cut-out bob: upper body down 2 px and back as one rigid piece; the tube arm follows a beat later (same 2 px, protagonist sword lag); legs, feet and loincloth still

move.note: a lurching walk on the protagonist's model: both legs step, six steps per tile rest to rest (a half step, four full steps, a closing half step), the near foot leading; 6 px lift; the pelvis settles 3 px after each landing; the torso pitches forward 4 degrees; the claw swings 4 px opposite the stepping leg and the tube 2 px; the loincloth trails 2 px

tether.note: swings the tube up across its front until it points about 45 degrees down toward its partner (the facing direction); braces with the knees, head up; shudders 1 px while the beam holds (contact 0.5), then lowers. Targets are relative to the rest tip (rest joints in 255 px: shoulder_near 154,88; elbow_near 178,124; tube cap about 215,215); a 125 px forward and 92 px lift puts the cap near 103,179 in the front view

jab.note: draws the tube back and up a little, then swings it forward in one heavy stroke until it points about 60 degrees down toward the target (contact), the weight shifting onto the front foot; holds a beat and recovers; the claw swings back as a counterweight; the weight sinks 3 px into the stroke; the stride foot stays planted and the trailing foot follows the body

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 4 degrees, the claw trails 1 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: jolts up 2 px as the charge leaves it, then the knees buckle: the pelvis drops 22 px over planted feet and it pitches forward 25 degrees over the tube, which lands on the floor ahead; the claw braces on the floor; head down; terminal pose held
